newsitem.title: USA: Identix unit gets $2 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Identix unit gets $2 mln contract.

text.p: Identix Inc said on Tuesday its Sydney-based Fingerscan Pty Ltd subsidiary had been awarded a transactions security/employee verification contract for a major Southeast Asian banking chain.
The company said the initial contract phase is valued at about $2 million and is scheduled to be shipped by the end of 1996.
The bank will install verification systems using Identix's TouchLock II throughout its several-hundred-branch network to replace the traditional password identification system.
